title: activation-framework.spec template variables
description: Values for templates/activation-framework.spec.md.j2 and templates/activation-framework.spec.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from activation-framework.spec.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

activation_event_name.title: Activation event name
activation_event_name.description: The one tracked event name (snake_case) that counts as activation. From section 'Activation event'.

data_cutoff.title: Data cutoff
data_cutoff.description: Date the data was pulled, YYYY-MM-DD; only cohorts closed before it enter the baseline. From section 'Baseline'.

series_id.title: Series id
series_id.description: Dashboard series identifier encoding event and window, e.g. activation-project_created-7d-v1. From section 'Weekly dashboard'.

window_days.title: Window days
window_days.description: Days from signup within which the event must occur. From section 'Activation event'.
